title: Code Violations
excerpt: This layer displays the locations of code violations across the city.
supported_claim: The city publishes locations of code violations, allowing neighborhood comparisons.
limits: This establishes an official public-data use case; it does not establish usage of Fieldwork or measured benefit.

title: Received 311 Service Requests
excerpt: This feature layer dataset displays the 311 service requests that have been received by the City of Montgomery.
supported_claim: The city publishes received service requests. These describe reported demand, not all neighborhood needs.
limits: This establishes an official public-data use case; it does not establish usage of Fieldwork or measured benefit.

title: Food Scores
excerpt: This dataset is useful for residents, business owners, and researchers to track food safety compliance
